description: MCP evidence policy for the interactive Kiro+Playwright execution path. The interactive-execution-skill reads this at runtime to choose the LOWEST-COST SUFFICIENT evidence level for every browser_* operation, preserving full correctness and failure diagnosis. Governs ONLY interactive execution — NOT HyperExecute (deterministic), NOT automation-skill generation, NOT product-knowledge discovery.
principle: The testcase is the execution contract. PLB is failure/evidence support, not a per-step dependency. Select the smallest MCP call that lets the next decision be made correctly. Never capture a full snapshot to reconfirm known information.

callClassification.rule: Before ANY browser_* call, classify it and pick the lowest sufficient category. Record the category in telemetry.

DIRECT_EXECUTION.when: Testcase step + known/verified evidence are sufficient to act (navigate, click, type, select on a known control).
forbidden: browser_snapshot to reconfirm a control already known

TARGETED_DISCOVERY.when: A known interaction cannot be executed (element not found / disabled / ambiguous) OR a single fact is needed to proceed.
TARGETED_DISCOVERY.prefer: browser_evaluate returning a COMPACT projection only
forbidden: document-wide element dumps when a scoped query suffices

SCOPED_DISCOVERY.when: Targeted discovery is insufficient; the relevant region's structure is needed.
SCOPED_DISCOVERY.prefer: browser_snapshot scoped to the relevant subtree via a target/ref or a depth limit — NOT the whole tree
forbidden: full-page browser_snapshot when a region suffices

FULL_DISCOVERY.when: Page structure is genuinely unknown, OR targeted+scoped discovery failed, OR broad accessibility context is required.
FULL_DISCOVERY.constraint: Exceptional, not default. Must be justified by a prior failed lower level or a genuinely unknown page.

FAILURE_INVESTIGATION.when: Action fails, assertion fails, expected state not reached, evidence invalidated, or unexpected page/state.
sequence: 1. Capture COMPACT failure state (step id, page, action, expected vs observed one-liners, error text verbatim).
2. Retrieve ONLY the relevant PLB slice for this page/component (never whole PKB).
3. Compare recorded expected behavior vs current application evidence.
4. Perform the smallest useful MCP investigation (start at TARGETED_DISCOVERY).
5. Escalate to SCOPED then FULL discovery ONLY if lower levels are inconclusive.
FAILURE_INVESTIGATION.contextCost: bounded; grows only as far as diagnosis requires

bannedByDefault: snapshot -> action -> snapshot -> action -> snapshot cadence
capturing a full browser_snapshot after every action
re-capturing an identical snapshot when nothing structurally changed
browser_evaluate dumps of the entire element inventory during normal execution
injecting whole PLB documents during a passing step
antiPatterns.afterActionRule: After an action, do NOT capture new structural evidence unless the NEXT decision requires structural information not already known. Prefer asserting the specific expected outcome (URL/text/element-state) via the narrowest check.

compactExecutionContext.description: The only state carried between steps. Keep it small; use references/hashes, never embed full DOM/PLB/snapshots.
rules: Do NOT store full snapshots, full DOM, full PLB, or prior tool outputs here.
Reference prior evidence by evidenceHash, not by re-embedding it.
Only include what the current/next step needs.

evidenceCache.description: Safe reuse of verified locators/observations to avoid re-discovery.
reuseAllowedWhen: a previous step in this run confirmed it
invalidateWhen: selector resolves to 0 or >1 at use time
runtime evidence contradicts the cached record
evidenceCache.onInvalidation: Drop the record and rediscover from TARGETED_DISCOVERY upward. NEVER use a stale record blindly.
evidenceCache.reuseMechanism: Reference by evidenceHash in compactExecutionContext.validatedSelectors — do NOT re-emit the full evidence payload into context.

plbUsage.normalExecution: Do NOT retrieve PLB for passing steps. Testcase is the contract.
plbUsage.failureOrAmbiguity: Retrieve ONLY the relevant slice: pkbRefs.screens[<page>] section or the specific component — never the whole PKB.
plbUsage.retrieveByReference: Prefer section anchors / component ids over whole-file reads.
plbUsage.noDuplication: Do not duplicate the same knowledge across testcase context + PLB + MCP result.

mustNot: remove or skip testcase steps or preconditions
weaken or skip assertions / expected-result checks
add arbitrary waits (use explicit wait-for a specific condition/element)
add blind locator fallbacks without evidence
mustPreserve: complete failure evidence retained for reporting
escalation to full discovery remains possible
